standardized_reference_scenario.reason: The public flow requires an email address before revealing an offer. No personal/contact data was submitted.

payout_modes.payout_timing: The public FAQ states payment occurs within at most 3 working days after inspection; estimated 3-4 working days from courier handover to receipt of funds.
payout_modes.preliminary_or_final: Final amount follows inspection and customer acceptance.

payout_modes.payout_timing: The public FAQ describes a higher offer and a slower path linked to resale; wording mentions 5-6 days or 1-3 weeks depending on model and cosmetic condition, while bank transfer follows sale.
payout_modes.preliminary_or_final: Preliminary online value, then technical inspection and final offer; exact payout timing semantics are partly ambiguous in the public copy.

payout_modes.payout_timing: The public FAQ says payment is expected on the 10th day after inspection and final-offer acceptance; bank processing may add 1-8 working days.
payout_modes.preliminary_or_final: Campaign/payment schedule; relation to the other offer amounts was not publicly exposed before the email gate.

handover_modes.details: The user can choose when and where the courier arrives; public copy calls shipping free.
The public selling page states handover is available through a parcel point.

offer_semantics.online_result: A preliminary/estimated offer is calculated from the online questionnaire, but the representative flow required an email address before displaying it.
offer_semantics.inspection: Rejoy technicians inspect the device after handover.
offer_semantics.final_offer: A final offer is sent after inspection and requires customer acceptance before payout.
offer_semantics.deductions: Public reviews and Rejoy responses state that profile details explain differences and deductions from the preliminary estimate.
offer_semantics.broken_device: The public FAQ states broken devices may still be accepted; repair costs are deducted from the device value.
offer_semantics.binding_status: Model-list amounts are maximum teaser values, not binding offers and not normalized scenario observations.

model_list.evidence: 39 public model cards with labels, source model IDs and visible maximum teaser values.

question_nodes_and_options_on_favorable_.evidence: Visible DOM text, DOM IDs and selected-route query values through the email gate.

conditional_branch_completeness.evidence: Only the favorable path was completed; mandatory stop rule prevented negative-branch continuation.

standardized_offer_prices.evidence: No amount was exposed before the email gate.

maximum_teaser_prices.evidence: Amounts were visible on model cards but have unspecified storage, condition and payout mode, so they are not comparable base-price evidence.

canonical_mapping.evidence: Mappings are research suggestions and must be validated by the independent normalization workstream before any production-registry change.

evidence_and_confidence_notes.important_limit: This snapshot contains no valid standardized reference price observation and must not by itself create an Apple Klinika base-price rule.
